tenderSchedule.title: Providing Gardner Manpower services on outsource Basis to Maddadka Horticulture farm, Belthangadi, Dakshina Kannada District.
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Gardner Manpower services on outsource Basis to Maddadka Horticulture farm, Belthangadi, Dakshina Kannada District.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KSHD Assitant Director Office Maddadka Horticulture Farm Belthangadi

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Remaining all other terms and conditions are as per the attached Tender Document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should furnish all Technical Documents as mentioned in the Tender Document.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Details of having satisfactorily provided horticulture services on an outsourced basis to various Government / Semi-Government organizations for at least 3 out of the last 4 years -2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 -confirmation letters shall be enclosed

Details of the manpower services currently being provided by the Tenderer to various Government / Semi-Government organizations, including details of the organizations to which manpower has been provided and the number of personnel deployed in each organization -copies of the work orders issued by the respective organizations shall be enclosed
Details of the Tenderers annual turnover from providing manpower services during the last three years -copies of the audited reports shall be enclosed

EPF Registration Certificate and submit employee-wise copies of the EPF payment challans for the employees to whom services were previously provided by the Tenderers organization or No-Dues Certificate regarding any outstanding payment dues shall be submitted from the concerned Department/Office.

ESI Registration Certificate and submit employee-wise copies of the ESI payment challans for the employees to whom services were previously provided by the Tenderers organization or No-Dues Certificate regarding any outstanding payment dues shall be submitted from the concerned Department/Office.
PAN card Copy and Income Tax Returns filed for the last three years -2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26

The Tenderer shall specify whether the bidder is an individual or a firm/organization. In case of a firm/organization, the registration details shall be furnished and copies of the relevant registration certificates shall be enclosed.
The Tenderer shall submit a notarized affidavit on a Rs. 100/- stamp paper stating that the firm/agency has not been blacklisted by any Government or Semi-Government organization.
